high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "ma2wavy," who posted it 2 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The photo is set at "Wonderyard Garden + Table," as indicated by the location tag in the bottom right corner of the image. The main focus of the image is a hand holding a cocktail glass. The cocktail has a layered appearance with a pinkish-red liquid at the bottom and a white foam on top, which could be dry ice or a similar effect, as there is also a visible cloud of vapor rising from the drink. The glass is a classic coupe
